# Henotic Diagnostics

> Henotic Diagnostics is a NABL-accredited medical diagnostic and imaging center in Kharghar, Navi Mumbai, India. Founded in 2012, it offers advanced 3.0T MRI, 128-slice CT, PET-CT, ultrasound, pathology, cardiac diagnostics, and genetic testing with same-day reports. Open 24 hours, 7 days a week.

## Key Facts

- **Full Name**: Henotic Diagnostics Centre
- **Type**: Medical Diagnostic & Imaging Center (DiagnosticLab)
- **Location**: Second floor, Millennium Empire, Business Park, Plot No 47, D Mart Rd, Sector 15, Kharghar, Panvel, Maharashtra 410210, India
- **Phone**: +91 88793 27184 | +91 93728 53584
- **Email**: henoticdiagnostics@gmail.com
- **Hours**: Open 24 hours, all 7 days
- **Accreditations**: NABL, AERB, PCPNDT, ISO certified
- **Rating**: 4.9/5 (1,030+ Google reviews)
- **Equipment**: 3.0 Tesla MRI Scanner, 128-Slice CT Scanner, Digital PET-CT, 4D Ultrasound
- **Service Area**: Mumbai, Navi Mumbai, Thane, Panvel, Kharghar, and surrounding areas

## Diagnostic Services

- [MRI Scan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/mri-scan): 3.0T MRI for brain, spine, joints, abdomen, and whole-body scans
- [CT Scan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/ct-scan): 128-slice CT for HRCT chest, brain, abdomen, and CT angiography
- [PET-CT Scan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/pet-scan): Whole-body FDG PET-CT for oncology, cardiac, and neurology
- [Ultrasound](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/ultrasound): Abdominal, pelvic, obstetric, and 4D ultrasound imaging
- [Blood Tests](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/blood-test): CBC, lipid profile, thyroid, diabetes, liver, kidney function tests
- [Full Body Checkup](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/full-body-check-up): Comprehensive health screening packages
- [2D Echo](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/2d-echo): Echocardiography and cardiac function assessment
- [ECG](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/ecg): Electrocardiogram for heart rhythm analysis
- [Mammography](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/mammography): Digital mammography for breast cancer screening
- [DEXA Bone Scan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/dexa-bone-scan): Bone density measurement for osteoporosis screening
- [Pregnancy Sonography](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/pregnancy-sonography): NT scan, anomaly scan, growth scan for expectant mothers
- [Color Doppler](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/color-doppler): Vascular, carotid, renal, and obstetric doppler studies
- [Liver Fibroscan](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/liver-fibroscan): Non-invasive liver stiffness and fibrosis assessment
- [Genetic Testing](https://www.henoticdiagnostics.com/services/prenatal-test): NIPT, karyotype, carrier screening, and DNA analysis
